optimize-header-layout-performance-with-.text: The comment's premise is that the parent of .extra-info-wrapper stays float-based so order() is a no-op. At head .extra-info-wrapper is rendered only by header-extra-info (header-extra-info.hbs:1), invoked inside the header's div.contents (header.hbs:2, :94), and this PR makes .contents a flex container with align-items:center (common/base/header.scss:15-18). So order(2) is not a no-op and the parent is not float-based; the removed 5px offset is replaced by flex centering plus line-height:1.5 (topic.scss:30-32). The #topic-title bullet margin is untouched (topic.scss:10-14). Since the stated fact is false, this is a hallucination, not merely an unproven defect.

add-html-sanitizer-for-translated-messag.text: The regex is imprecise as stated: ANCHOR_PATTERN "</?a[^>]*>" (VerifyMessageProperties.java:145) also matches <abbr>, <area>, <audio>, and santizeAnchors strips such a tag before the policy runs (lines 88, 153-155). But it strips only a tag that is byte-identical to one in the English source, so a translation can only carry a tag the project's own English file already has, which is the exemption the method is designed to grant anchors. No message bundle at head contains such tags, and this is a build-time verifier, not a runtime sanitizer. Real but no practical effect: nit.

implement-recovery-key-support-for-user-.text: The facts hold: getCredentials rebuilds the model from the raw list via createFromValues (BackwardsCompatibilityUserStorage.java:237-241), and isValid accepts any stored code via anyMatch without consuming it (:326-340). But this is a testsuite fixture provider with no real federated users. The only test added (BackwardsCompatibilityUserStorageTest testRecoveryKeysSetupAndLogin) does one login that expects code 0, which the fixture handles correctly. The simplified consumption state affects no production path and no test assertion, so it is a real but non-impactful fixture shortcut: nit.

add-guest-management-functionality-to-ex.text: Guests are created with name "" (addGuests.handler.ts:83-90) and appended to the existing booking via createMany (:92-106), so the original booker row, inserted earlier, is attendees[0] in practice. organizer-add-guests-email.ts:28 follows the same attendees[0] convention as OrganizerScheduledEmail and the rest of cal.com's emails. The missing orderBy is a theoretical ordering guarantee shared by every booking email, not a defect this PR introduces. The comment's claim that adding nameless guests makes the subject render an empty name does not happen on the normal path.

feat-2fa-backup-codes-cal-com#pf-muse-C2.text: The new branch throws on a missing CALENDSO_ENCRYPTION_KEY (disable.ts:49-52), matching the existing TOTP branch, which also throws for the same misconfiguration (disable.ts:75-83, 86-91). Even a JSON {error: InternalServerError} would hit the else branch and show 'something_went_wrong' (DisableTwoFactorModal.tsx:77-78), which is exactly what the catch at :80-82 shows for the thrown 500. So there is no user-visible difference. It fires only on a server misconfiguration, so there is nothing to report.
